title: Uncleared Check and ACH Funds on Insurance Claim Repairs Refunds
content:
Funds that are not yet final are held from an overpayment refund on an Insurance Claim Repairs repair order: the most recent check payment when it was received fewer than the check clearing days of **10 days** before today; otherwise the most recent ACH payment when it was received fewer than the ACH return days of **5 days** before today; otherwise nothing. Days are calendar days from the payment's entry date to today, and the amount held is the amount of that payment.

The amount held is taken off the excess on the repair order before the refund is limited to the payment it returns; the refund never falls below zero.

## Clearing table

| Most recent check payment | Most recent ACH payment | Held |
|---|---|---|
| received fewer than 10 days ago | any | that check payment |
| received 10 days or more ago, or no check payment | received fewer than 5 days ago | that ACH payment |
| received 10 days or more ago, or no check payment | received 5 days or more ago, or no ACH payment | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical payments)

- Check of USD 400.00 received 9 days ago: USD 400.00 held.
- The same check at 10 days, and an ACH payment of USD 250.00 received 4 days ago: USD 250.00 held.
- The same check at 10 days, and the ACH payment at 5 days: nothing held.
- A check received 3 days ago and an ACH payment received 1 day ago: the check governs — only the check's amount is held.
